title: Replica Symmetry Breaking and Algorithmic Thresholds in Empirical Risk Minimization under Multi-Index Model
abstract: arXiv:2606.28573v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modern machine learning models are trained by optimizing high-dimensional non-convex empirical risk functions. Such cost functions can have a multitude of local optima and yet, gradient-based optimization appears to converge to near-global optima.   Within a simple supervised learning setting, we develop a precise picture of which parts of the empirical risk landscape are accessible by polynomial-time algorithms. We are given i.i.d. pairs $\{(\boldsymbol{x}_i,y_i):\; 1 \le i\le n\}$ with $\boldsymbol{x}_i\in \mathbb{R}^d$ standard Gaussian feature vectors, and $y_i\in\mathbb{R}$ response variables that depend on $\boldsymbol{x}_i$ through their projections on an unknown $k$-dimensional subspace. translated_title: 多指标模型下经验风险最小化中的副本对称破缺与算法阈值
translated_abstract: 现代机器学习模型通过优化高维非凸的经验风险函数进行训练。这类代价函数可能存在大量的局部最优解，然而基于梯度的优化方法却似乎能够收敛到接近全局最优的解。在一个简单的监督学习设定中，我们构建了一幅精确的图景，刻画经验风险地形中哪些部分是多项式时间算法可以到达的。我们给定独立同分布的数据对 {(𝒙ᵢ, yᵢ): 1 ≤ i ≤ n}，其中 𝒙ᵢ ∈ ℝᵈ 为标准高斯特征向量，yᵢ ∈ ℝ 为响应变量，其通过 𝒙ᵢ 在一个未知的 k 维子空间上的投影而依赖于 𝒙ᵢ。我们使用经验风险最小化来学习一个依赖于数据的 m 维投影的模型（例如，具有 m 个神经元的神经网络）。我们提出了一种增量近似消息传递算法，并精确刻画……（原文摘要不完整，此处为已有部分的翻译）
tldr: 该论文在多指标模型的监督学习设定下提出增量近似消息传递（IAMP）算法，精确刻画了经验风险地形中多项式时间算法可到达的区域，并揭示了副本对称破缺现象与算法阈值。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an incremental approximate message passing (IAMP) algorithm to precisely characterize which regions of the empirical risk landscape are accessible by polynomial-time algorithms in a supervised learning setting under the multi-index model, revealing replica symmetry breaking phenomena and algorithmic thresholds.
